scenarios.prompt: List what-if branches for this book — show branches.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM composition_work WHERE source_work_id='{project_id}'
seed_assert.why: ZERO derivatives. This is the EMPTY case by construction, and it is the shape that caught composition_conformance_status in batch 11: the honest answer is that only the canonical Work exists, and describing what a divergence WOULD hold is the failure. Note the tool's own description says it returns 'the canonical Work + every branch', so a correct reply names ONE Work, not none.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a read-intent turn changes the store, OR the reply reports branches a book with none can have, OR it says there is NOTHING at all — the canonical Work is always in the list, so 'no results' would contradict the tool's own contract. This is the D-ABSENT-ENTITY-READS-AS-UNUSED distinction in a third shape: 'no branches yet' must not become 'no book'.

ship_audit.empty_case: This scenario IS the empty case — a book with no derivatives must still report its canonical Work.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — book-scoped via any Work's project_id; another account's project must be refused.
